name: How do interior painters protect my furniture and flooring?

mainEntity.name: How do interior painters protect my furniture and flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional interior painters take significant steps to protect your belongings. They typically use high-quality drop cloths to cover all flooring surfaces, including carpets, hardwoods, and tiles. Furniture that cannot be moved from the room is carefully covered with plastic sheeting or additional drop cloths and often shifted away from the walls. This meticulous protection prevents paint splatters and dust from reaching your valuables, ensuring a clean and tidy workspace.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior painters protect your belongings using drop cloths for flooring and plastic sheeting for furniture, ensuring a clean workspace and preventing paint splatters.
